title: Toplum
canDo: Bağlaçları ve söylem belirleyicilerini (however, despite, as a result, therefore) doğru noktalamayla kullanabilir, iyi yapılandırılmış paragraflar kurabilir, toplumsal konularda dengeli görüş bildirebilir ve B2 sınav standartlarında bir görüş yazısı (essay) yazabilirim.
grammar: ekleme ve karşıtlık: moreover, however, although, despite
neden, sonuç ve amaç: due to, as a result, therefore, so that
paragraf yapısı: topic sentence ve destek

liveClass.title: Münazara kulübü
liveClass.goal: Sınıf iki takıma ayrılır ve güncel bir toplumsal konuyu tartışır (Should public transport be free? Should voting be compulsory?). Her takım 3 argüman hazırlar ve sunarken söylem belirleyicilerini (Firstly, Moreover, However, As a result) kullanır. Karşı takım While it is true that... ile cevap verir. Sonunda herkes kendi görüşünü 4 cümlelik bir paragrafla özetler.

lessons.title: Üstelik ve ancak

discover.title: Görüş köşesi: Ücretsiz toplu taşıma
discover.body:
Several European cities have made public transport completely free. Should our city do the same?

Free buses and trams would reduce traffic. Moreover, they would help families on low incomes, who spend a large part of their budget on travel. In addition, fewer cars would mean cleaner air.

However, the plan has some serious drawbacks. Free transport would cost the city millions every year. Although supporters say the money would come from parking fees, critics doubt that this would be enough.

Despite these concerns, I believe the idea is worth trying. Some cities have seen a big increase in passengers, whereas others have seen very little change in traffic. Nevertheless, even a small improvement in air quality would benefit everyone.

questions.prompt: Who would free transport especially help?

options: It would cost the city millions.

learn.explanation:
**Ekleme:**

| Kelime | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **and, also** | cümle içinde | It's cheap **and** fast. |
| **In addition, / Moreover, / Furthermore,** | cümle başında + **virgül** | **Moreover,** it's eco-friendly. |
| **as well as** | + isim / -ing | **As well as** reducing traffic, it would ... |

**Karşıtlık:**

| Kelime | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **but** | iki cümleyi bağlar | It's cheap, **but** it's slow. |
| **However, / Nevertheless,** | **yeni cümle** başında + virgül | It's cheap. **However,** it's slow. |
| **although / even though** | + **özne + fiil** | **Although** it's cheap, it's slow. |
| **despite / in spite of** | + **isim / -ing** | **Despite** the cost, ... / **Despite being** cheap, ... |
| **whereas / while** | iki zıt durumu karşılaştırır | Cities are noisy, **whereas** villages are quiet. |

**En sık hatalar:**

- ~~Despite it is expensive~~ → **Although** it is expensive / **Despite** the cost / **Despite being** expensive
- ~~Despite of~~ → **Despite** / **In spite of**
- ~~It's cheap, however it's slow.~~ → It's cheap. **However,** it's slow. (ya da: It's cheap; however, it's slow.)

**Not:** *Despite the fact that* + özne + fiil de kullanılabilir.

examples.en: Although the plan is expensive, it would benefit everyone.
examples.tr: Plan pahalı olsa da herkese fayda sağlar.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "-e rağmen" ve "-mesine rağmen" aynı kelimeyle kurulur, ama İngilizcede yapı değişir: despite + isim (yağmura rağmen = despite the rain), although + cümle (yağmasına rağmen = although it was raining). "Despite it was raining" Türkçe konuşanların en sık hatasıdır. Ayrıca "however" bir bağlaç değildir; iki cümleyi virgülle birleştiremez.

options: Despite it was cold, we went out.
Although it was cold, we went out.
Despite the cold, we went out.
Although the cold, we went out.
Despite of the cost, they did it.
Despite the cost, they did it.

task.prompt: "Should public transport be free?" sorusu hakkında 1 dakikalık bir görüş açıklayın. En az 2 ekleme (moreover, in addition, as well as) ve en az 3 karşıtlık (however, although, despite, whereas) yapısı kullanın.
task.modelAnswer: I think public transport should be free, at least for students and older people. It would reduce traffic. Moreover, it would help people on low incomes. In addition, it would be good for the environment. However, it would be very expensive for the city. Although some people say the money could come from higher taxes, I don't think that's fair for everyone. Despite these problems, I believe it's worth trying, because young people tend to use buses a lot, whereas older people often drive.

lessons.title: Neden ve sonuç
lessons.goal: Neden, sonuç ve amaç bildiren yapıları (due to, as a result, therefore, so that, in order to) doğru kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Haber analizi: Köyler neden boşalıyor?
discover.body:
Over the last fifty years, millions of people in Turkey have moved from villages to cities. As a result, many villages now have only a few elderly residents.

The main reason is the lack of jobs. Due to modern farming methods, fewer people are needed to work the land. Young people therefore leave in order to find work or study at university.

Another factor is access to services. Because many villages don't have hospitals or secondary schools, families move so that their children can get a better education.

Consequently, cities have grown rapidly, which has led to problems such as traffic, high rents and pollution.

In recent years, however, some young people have started moving back to villages. Thanks to fast internet, they can work remotely and enjoy a quieter life.

questions.prompt: Why are fewer people needed to work the land?
Why are some young people moving back?
options: Fast internet lets them work remotely.
questions.explanation: "Thanks to fast internet, they can work remotely"

learn.explanation:
**Neden:**

| Kelime | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **because / as / since** | + özne + fiil | **Because** there are no jobs, people leave. |
| **because of / due to / owing to** | + **isim** | **Due to** the lack of jobs, people leave. |
| **thanks to** | + isim (olumlu sebep) | **Thanks to** the internet, they can work remotely. |

**Sonuç:**

| Kelime | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **so** | cümle içinde | There are no jobs, **so** people leave. |
| **As a result, / Consequently, / Therefore,** | yeni cümle başında + virgül | **As a result,** villages are empty. |
| **therefore** (cümle ortasında) | özne + **therefore** + fiil | Young people **therefore** leave. |
| **lead to / result in** | + isim | Growth **has led to** traffic problems. |

**Amaç:**

| Kelime | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **to / in order to** | + fiil | They leave **in order to** find work. |
| **so that** | + özne + **can / could / will / would** | They move **so that** their children **can** study. |
| **in order not to** | + fiil (olumsuz) | **in order not to** be late |

**Dikkat:**

- ~~Due to there are no jobs~~ → **Due to the lack of** jobs / **Because** there are no jobs
- ~~for to find work~~ → **to** find work / **in order to** find work

Amaç için Türkçedeki "-mek için" yapısı "for to" diye çevrilmemelidir: "I came for to see you" yanlış, "I came to see you" doğrudur.

task.prompt: Şehrinizde ya da ülkenizde son yıllarda değişen bir toplumsal durumu anlatın (göç, kira artışı, uzaktan çalışma, nüfus yaşlanması, vb.). Nedenlerini (due to, because of, as), sonuçlarını (as a result, therefore, has led to) ve insanların bu değişime karşı neler yaptığını (in order to, so that) anlatın.
task.modelAnswer: In my city, more and more people are working from home. This is mainly due to the pandemic, when companies had to close their offices. As a result, many people realised that they didn't need to live in the city centre. Therefore, they moved to smaller towns nearby, where houses are cheaper. This has led to higher prices in those towns too. Some companies now offer shared offices in suburbs so that people can work near their homes. People also take online courses in order to learn new digital skills.

lessons.title: Paragraf kurmak
lessons.goal: Bir topic sentence, destekleyici cümleler, örnekler ve sonuç cümlesiyle iyi yapılandırılmış bir paragraf yazabilirim.

discover.title: İki paragraf: hangisi daha iyi?
discover.body:
Paragraph A:
Volunteering is good. My friend volunteers. It's nice. You meet people. Some people don't have time. I volunteered once at an animal shelter. Also it's good for your CV.

Paragraph B:
Volunteering benefits both the community and the volunteers themselves. Firstly, it provides essential help to people and organisations that cannot afford to pay for it, such as food banks, animal shelters and care homes. Secondly, volunteers often develop valuable skills, including teamwork, communication and leadership, which can improve their job prospects. For instance, a recent survey found that many employers see volunteering experience as an advantage. Finally, research suggests that helping others can reduce stress and increase happiness. For these reasons, volunteering should be encouraged in schools and workplaces.

questions.prompt: Which paragraph has a clear topic sentence?
questions.explanation: "Volunteering benefits both the community and the volunteers themselves."

questions.prompt: How many reasons does Paragraph B give?

learn.explanation:
**İyi bir paragrafın yapısı:**

| Bölüm | İşlev | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **1. Topic sentence** | Paragrafın ana fikri. Genellikle ilk cümle. | *Volunteering benefits both the community and the volunteers.* |
| **2. Supporting sentences** | Ana fikri destekleyen gerekçeler | *Firstly, ... Secondly, ...* |
| **3. Examples / evidence** | Somut örnek, rakam, deneyim | *For instance, ... / such as ...* |
| **4. Concluding sentence** | Ana fikri bağlayan / özetleyen cümle | *For these reasons, ...* |

**Sıralama:** *Firstly / First of all, ... Secondly, ... Thirdly, ... Finally / Lastly, ...*

**Örnek verme:**

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **For example, / For instance,** | cümle başında + virgül |
| **such as** | + isim: *places **such as** food banks* |
| **including** | + isim: *skills, **including** teamwork* |
| **like** | (daha samimi) |

**İyi bir topic sentence:**

- Çok genel değil: ~~Volunteering is good.~~
- Çok dar değil: ~~I volunteered at an animal shelter.~~
- Tartışılabilir ve net: ✓ *Volunteering benefits both the community and the volunteers themselves.*

**Kural:** Bir paragraf = **bir ana fikir**. Yeni bir fikir yeni bir paragraf ister.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçe kompozisyonda paragraflar bazen uzun bir girişle ya da bir hikâyeyle başlar ve ana fikir sona saklanır. İngilizce akademik ve sınav yazısında ana fikir genellikle paragrafın ilk cümlesinde (topic sentence) açıkça verilir. Okuyucu sadece ilk cümleleri okuyarak bütün metnin özetini çıkarabilmelidir.

practice.audioText: Today I'll show you how to write a good paragraph. Start with a clear topic sentence that tells the reader your main idea. Then give two or three supporting points, each with an example. Finally, finish with a sentence that links back to your main idea. Remember: one paragraph, one idea.

practice.answer: Firstly volunteering provides help to people who need it.
practice.translation: İlk olarak, gönüllülük ihtiyacı olan insanlara yardım sağlar.

task.prompt: Aşağıdaki konulardan birini seçin ve sözlü bir "paragraf" kurun (1 dakika): (a) Learning a foreign language at a young age has many benefits. (b) Cities should have more green spaces. Topic sentence ile başlayın, Firstly / Secondly / Finally ile 3 destekleyici nokta verin, en az bir örnek (for instance, such as) ekleyin ve bir sonuç cümlesiyle bitirin.
task.modelAnswer: Cities should have more green spaces. Firstly, parks and gardens improve people's physical health, because they encourage walking, running and cycling. Secondly, green spaces are good for mental health. For instance, studies suggest that spending time in nature can reduce stress. Finally, trees and plants help to clean the air and keep cities cooler in summer, which is important as temperatures rise. For these reasons, I believe every neighbourhood should have a park within walking distance.

lessons.title: Dengeli görüş
lessons.goal: Toplumsal konularda farklı görüşleri dengeli bir şekilde sunabilir, karşı görüşü kabul edip cevaplayabilir ve kendi görüşümü belirtebilirim.

lines.text: Today's question: should children under sixteen be banned from social media? Dr Yalçın, what's your view?

lines.speaker: Dr Yalçın
lines.text: On the one hand, there's growing evidence that heavy use can affect young people's mental health. On the other hand, a complete ban might be very difficult to enforce.

lines.speaker: Dr Yalçın

learn.explanation:
**İki tarafı sunmak:**

| Kalıp | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ...** | **On the one hand,** it's cheap. **On the other hand,** it's slow. |
| **Some people argue / believe / claim that ...** | **Some people argue that** taxes should be higher. |
| **Others / Critics, however, ...** | **Critics, however,** say it's unfair. |
| **It could be argued that ...** | **It could be argued that** bans don't work. (kişisiz, resmî) |
| **Supporters / Opponents of ... say ...** | **Opponents of** the plan say ... |

**Karşı görüşü kabul edip cevaplamak (concession):**

| Kalıp | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **While it is true that ..., ...** | **While it is true that** it's expensive, it would save money in the long term. |
| **That's a valid point, but ...** | (konuşmada) |
| **Admittedly, ... However, ...** | **Admittedly,** there are risks. **However,** ... |

**Kendi görüşünü belirtmek:**

| Samimi → Resmî |
|---|
| I think ... / In my opinion, ... / Personally, I believe ... |
| From my point of view, ... / In my view, ... |
| I am (not) in favour of ... / I am strongly against ... |
| **It seems to me that** ... / **I would argue that** ... |

**Dikkat:** ~~According to me~~ İngilizcede doğal değildir. → **In my opinion** / **In my view**

examples.en: On the one hand, technology connects us. On the other hand, it can make us feel lonely.
examples.tr: Bir yandan teknoloji bizi birbirimize bağlıyor. Öte yandan bizi yalnız hissettirebilir.

examples.en: While it is true that cars are convenient, they cause a lot of pollution.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "bana göre" ifadesini "according to me" diye çevirmek çok yaygın bir hatadır; İngilizcede "according to" başkalarının görüşü için kullanılır (according to experts). Kendi görüşünüz için "In my opinion" ya da "In my view" deyin. Ayrıca İngilizce tartışma kültüründe karşı görüşü önce kabul etmek (While it is true that...) daha güçlü ve ikna edici bir izlenim bırakır.

task.prompt: Bir radyo programına konuk olarak katıldığınızı düşünün. Konu: "Should university education be free for everyone?" İki tarafı da sunun (On the one hand / On the other hand, Some people argue / Critics say), karşı görüşü kabul edip cevaplayın (While it is true that ...) ve kendi görüşünüzü belirtin (Personally, I am in favour of / against ...).
task.modelAnswer: That's a difficult question. On the one hand, free university education would give everyone the same opportunities, regardless of their family's income. Some people argue that education is a right, not a privilege. On the other hand, it would be extremely expensive, and critics say taxpayers who never went to university would be paying for others. While it is true that it would cost a lot, I think an educated population benefits the whole country in the long run. Personally, I'm in favour of free education, but perhaps students should do some community work in return.

lessons.title: Görüş yazısı
lessons.goal: Giriş, gelişme ve sonuç bölümleriyle, söylem belirleyicileri ve dengeli argümanlar içeren B2 sınav standartlarında bir essay yazabilirim.

discover.title: Örnek essay: Should the minimum voting age be 16?
discover.body:
In many countries, people can vote from the age of 18. However, some countries, such as Austria, have lowered the voting age to 16. This essay will examine both sides of the argument before giving my own opinion.

Those in favour of votes at 16 argue that young people are directly affected by political decisions, for example on education and the environment. Moreover, at sixteen, many young people work, pay taxes and can even get married in some countries. Therefore, it seems fair that they should have a voice.

On the other hand, critics claim that most sixteen-year-olds are not mature enough to make political decisions. They also point out that young people might be easily influenced by their parents, teachers or social media.

While it is true that some teenagers are not interested in politics, the same can be said of many adults. In fact, research suggests that people who vote at a young age are more likely to keep voting throughout their lives.

In conclusion, although there are valid concerns, I believe the benefits of lowering the voting age outweigh the drawbacks. If combined with better political education in schools, votes at 16 could create a more active and engaged generation.

learn.explanation:
**Görüş yazısının (opinion / for-and-against essay) yapısı:**

| Paragraf | İçerik | Kalıplar |
|---|---|---|
| **1. Giriş** | Konuyu tanıt, bağlam ver, yazının amacını söyle | *In many countries, ... / Nowadays, ... / This essay will examine ...* |
| **2. Gelişme 1** | Bir tarafın argümanları + örnekler | *Those in favour of ... argue that ... / Firstly, ... Moreover, ...* |
| **3. Gelişme 2** | Diğer tarafın argümanları | *On the other hand, critics claim that ... / They also point out that ...* |
| **4. (İsteğe bağlı) Concession** | Karşı görüşü cevapla | *While it is true that ..., ...* |
| **5. Sonuç** | Özetle + kendi görüşün | *In conclusion, / To sum up, / All things considered, ... I believe ...* |

**Essay'de kaçınılması gerekenler:**

- **Kısaltmalar:** ~~don't, it's~~ → do not, it is
- **Çok samimi dil:** ~~stuff, kids, a lot of~~ → things, children, many / a great deal of
- **Sonuçta yeni argüman** eklemek
- **"I"yi aşırı kullanmak:** Görüşünüzü genellikle giriş ya da sonuçta belirtin.
- **Kanıtsız mutlak ifadeler:** ~~Everyone knows that ...~~ → *Many people believe that ...*

**Sınav ipucu (B2 First vb.):** Soruyu dikkatle okuyun, istenen her noktaya cevap verin, kelime sınırına uyun (genellikle 140–190 ya da 200–250) ve 5 dakikanızı plan için ayırın.

examples.tr: Bu yazı tartışmanın her iki tarafını da inceleyecek.

examples.en: All things considered, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
examples.tr: Her şey göz önüne alındığında avantajların dezavantajlardan ağır bastığına inanıyorum.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçe kompozisyonda giriş-gelişme-sonuç yapısı bilinir, ama İngilizce essay'de her paragrafın tek bir işlevi vardır ve bu işlev topic sentence'ta açıkça belirtilir. Türk öğrencilerin sık yaptığı hata, sonuç bölümünde yeni bir argüman eklemek ya da girişte çok uzun bir genel giriş yapmaktır ("Since the beginning of human history..."). Kısa, net ve konuya odaklı bir giriş en iyisidir.

task.prompt: Aşağıdaki essay sorusuna cevap verin (200–250 kelime): "Some people believe that all young people should do one year of community service (helping in hospitals, schools, or environmental projects) after finishing school. Do you agree?" Giriş, iki gelişme paragrafı ve bir sonuç yazın. Her paragrafa net bir topic sentence koyun; ekleme, karşıtlık, neden-sonuç ve örnek verme yapılarını kullanın; karşı görüşü kabul edip cevaplayın ve resmî bir üslup kullanın.
task.modelAnswer:
In some countries, young people are expected to spend a period of time serving their community after leaving school. This essay will consider the advantages and disadvantages of making one year of community service compulsory.

Those in favour of the idea argue that it would benefit both society and young people themselves. Firstly, hospitals, schools and environmental organisations often lack staff, and young volunteers could provide valuable support. Moreover, working with people from different backgrounds would help young people develop skills such as teamwork, patience and communication. As a result, they might become more responsible and confident adults.

On the other hand, critics claim that a compulsory year would delay young people's education and careers. Some students, for instance, might lose motivation to go to university after a year away from studying. In addition, forcing people to volunteer could mean that they do the work without real interest or care.

While it is true that a compulsory year has some drawbacks, I believe these could be reduced with careful planning. For example, young people could choose the type of service that suits their interests, and the year could count towards university applications.

In conclusion, although community service should perhaps not be strictly compulsory, I believe it should be strongly encouraged. All things considered, the benefits for society and for young people outweigh the disadvantages.

questions.prompt: Aşağıdaki essay sorusuna cevap verin (200–250 kelime): "Technology has made our lives better, but it has also made people more isolated. Discuss both views and give your own opinion." Giriş, iki gelişme ve sonuç paragrafı yazın; topic sentence'lar, ekleme / karşıtlık / neden-sonuç bağlaçları, örnekler, concession ve resmî üslup kullanın.
questions.modelAnswer:
Over the past twenty years, technology has transformed almost every area of our lives, from the way we work to the way we communicate. While many people believe that it has improved our quality of life, others argue that it has made us more isolated. This essay will examine both views.

There is no doubt that technology has brought enormous benefits. Firstly, it allows us to stay in touch with friends and family all over the world. For instance, video calls mean that grandparents can see their grandchildren every day, even if they live in another country. Moreover, technology has made many tasks faster and easier, such as banking, shopping and studying. As a result, people have more free time and more opportunities.

On the other hand, critics claim that technology has damaged face-to-face relationships. Many people spend hours on their phones, even when they are with friends. In addition, some research suggests that heavy use of social media is linked to loneliness, particularly among teenagers.

While it is true that technology can be used in unhealthy ways, I would argue that the problem lies in how we use it, not in the technology itself. Used wisely, it can bring people together rather than push them apart.

In conclusion, although technology has created some new social problems, I believe it has made our lives better overall. The key is to find a healthy balance between our online and offline lives.
